title: Not For Heavy Use
text: Not For Heavy Use. This is a really cheaply made CD case. It does the job, but it would be best for CDs you don’t need to be taking out very often. We are using it for our kids’ math curriculum discs and the daily wear on it really shows. It will have to be replaced very soon.
